confidence_vocabulary.verified: Directly read from executable scoring code, an immutable specification, or a retained result payload.
confidence_vocabulary.reconstructed: Derived mechanically from verified code or retained fields.
confidence_vocabulary.unresolved: Not asserted as a frozen fact.

pck.formula: For each renderer-qualified reference joint j, PCK@t = sum_j 1[d_j <= t * s_person] / N_eligible, where d_j is Euclidean pixel distance between the source-derived reference and detector prediction and s_person is the diagonal of the axis-aligned extent of valid reference joints.
pck.coordinate_space: The generated image/output bucket. Source keypoints are scaled to the resize-to-cover image and shifted by the center-crop origin before comparison; detector output coordinates are returned in the generated image's original pixel coordinates.
pck.normalization: Per-person diagonal sqrt((max_x-min_x)^2 + (max_y-min_y)^2) over renderer-qualified reference joints; not width, height, max-side, torso, or head scale.
pck.aggregation: Globally pooled correct eligible joints across all evaluable images; not a mean of joints, people, or images.
pck.eligibility: A COCO-17 reference joint must be source-visible and analytically represented by the source skeleton renderer. A reference person must have at least two eligible joints and a nonzero diagonal.
pck.missing_prediction_joint: Remains in the eligible denominator and contributes zero correct counts.
pck.unmatched_reference: Its eligible joints remain in the denominator and contribute zero correct counts.
pck.extra_generated_person: Counted as unmatched_predicted_people but does not directly change the PCK denominator or numerator.

person_detection_and_matching.detector: torchvision.models.detection.keypointrcnn_resnet50_fpn with KeypointRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights.DEFAULT = COCO_V1, producing COCO-17 keypoints.
person_detection_and_matching.matching: One-to-one Hungarian assignment (scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment). Edge cost is the unnormalized mean Euclidean pixel distance over shared valid (reference and predicted keypoint confidence >= 0.5) joints; pairs with no shared valid joint are forbidden.
person_detection_and_matching.matched_count: Number of finite-cost Hungarian pairs; it is a person-pair count, not a correct-joint count.
person_detection_and_matching.reference_representation: Authoritative COCO/Human-Art source joints, analytically filtered by renderer topology then mapped through recorded resize/crop geometry.
person_detection_and_matching.generated_representation: Detector boxes, person scores, and 17 keypoints from the generated RGB image after score filtering.

source.locator: KeypointRCNN constructor signature/source inspected during audit

clip.comparison: Each generated RGB image versus the exact evaluation prompt used to generate that image; never source RGB. Prompt-injection uses the frozen injected prompt text.
clip.preprocessing: CLIPProcessor receives RGB PIL image and one text string with padding, truncation, and max_length=clip.config.text_config.max_position_embeddings; processor-defined image resize/crop/normalization applies.
clip.score: Cosine similarity of get_image_features and get_text_features projected embeddings, computed explicitly as dot(a,b)/(||a|| ||b||), with no logit scale.
clip.aggregation: Arithmetic mean over all successful generated samples; median and population standard deviation are also retained. It is independent of PCK matching and includes every generated image in a complete benchmark.
clip.failure_handling: The frozen headline paths require every generation before scoring; missing images raise rather than being silently dropped.

geometry.native: Uses the persisted paired cached-latent bucket and validates source_size, resized_size, crop_box, and bucket against the canonical resize-to-cover + center-crop calculation. The original paired RGB/control preprocessing applies the same geometry to both; final generation consumes the cached control latent.
geometry.dynamic_768: Only in the five-condition ablation. It chooses the closest log-aspect-ratio bucket from [(768,768),(704,896),(896,704),(640,960),(960,640),(576,1024),(1024,576),(512,1152),(1152,512)], resize-to-cover, then center-crops the authoritative control raster and VAE-encodes it with the per-condition sampling seed. It does not use source RGB. Reference joints are independently transformed through the matching dynamic geometry before PCK.
geometry.resize_crop: scale=max(bucket_w/source_w,bucket_h/source_h); resized dimensions use round; crop origin is integer floor half-excess. Aspect ratio is preserved before crop; no padding is used.
geometry.metric_bias_note: Native and dynamic results are not a pure resolution-only comparison: output buckets, resized control raster, crop framing, and VAE control encoding differ. PCK remains internally aligned within each mode because its source reference is transformed by that mode's geometry.

evaluation_limitations: Hungarian person association uses mean raw pixel-distance cost over shared valid joints, while PCK scoring afterward uses the matched reference person's diagonal normalization. This is the defined association-and-scoring procedure, not an invalidation of the metric.
unresolved: The retained result payloads do not pin a separate detector-weight file SHA-256 or the original Transformers package version; model identifiers and executable scoring code are pinned.
The exact CLIPProcessor transform parameter values are delegated to the named Hugging Face processor checkpoint rather than duplicated in repository code.
Detector internal resize defaults are reconstructed from audit-time torchvision 0.22.0 source; PCK uses postprocessed output coordinates in the generated-image coordinate space.
